_readme: Everything in this file is shown on the public lobby page. Never put kids' names, gamertags, phone numbers or addresses here. Edits show up on the next page load; no restart needed. After editing, check it with: docker exec arcade-lobby python3 -m json.tool /config/config.json
headline: Welcome to the family arcade.
intro: The cousins' private Minecraft world, plus classic console nights for the grown-ups, hosted by Eric. Pick your device below and you'll be playing in a few minutes.
announcement: Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 comes out October 27. The server updates itself overnight, so you can keep playing after you update.
_season_help: auto picks a theme by date (Halloween in October, winter Dec 1 to Jan 6). Or set halloween, winter or none.

minecraft.mode: Survival on easy, with keep-inventory on

arcade._systems_help: id: use the ES-DE folder name (n64, gc, ps2, psx, dreamcast, wii, wiiu, snes) so the page and the VM match. status: ready (shown with its games), soon (shown greyed as Coming soon), hidden (not shown). Order here is the order on the page.

play_hours: The Minecraft world is open every day. It restarts at 4 AM Pacific for updates and backups, which takes about a minute.
rules: Be kind. Treat everyone the way you'd want to be treated.
Build your own stuff. Don't break or take anything someone else made.
Ask before you go into someone's house or base.

rules.text: Keep private things private. No last names, addresses, schools or phone numbers in chat.
Chat is checked by a moderator bot. If a message doesn't send, say it another way.
Chat is off in this world. Signs and books are for labels and stories, not messages, and never for private things like last names, addresses or schools.

rules: If something feels wrong, stop playing and tell a grown-up and Eric.
Take breaks, and log off when your grown-up says it's time.

rulebook._help: Shown under the short rules. The "moderated" items quote the moderator numbers in minecraft/moderation/settings.json (strikes_to_mute, strike_window_minutes, mute_minutes); keep them matching.

chapters.title: Chat
items: A moderator bot reads every message before anyone else sees it.
These don't get sent: swear words, mean words like "stupid" or "shut up", links, and asking other players to add you on another app.
Private things don't get sent either: your address, phone number, email, school or last name. The bot also stops questions asking for them.
Private messages (/tell, /msg, /w) are off. Everything is said in the open so everyone can see it.
Spamming the same message, or lots of messages really fast, gets blocked too.
Writing in ALL CAPS is fine, but it shows up in lowercase.

chapters.title: Chat
items: Text chat is turned off for everyone, so nobody can send messages in the world.
Signs, books and pet names are still allowed. Keep them friendly, and never write private things like your last name, address, school or phone number.
Want to plan a build together? Do it with your grown-up's help, or on a game night with Eric.

chapters.title: Building and playing
items: Build your own stuff. Don't break, change or take things from someone else's build or chests.
Ask before you go into someone's house or base, or build right next to it.
No traps, lava, or TNT near other people's things. (TNT, creepers and fire can't wreck builds on this server anyway.)
Share the farms and the community areas. Put things back where you found them.
Keep builds, signs, names and skins friendly. Anything you'd be embarrassed for your grown-up to see doesn't belong here.
Players can't hurt each other here, and you keep your stuff when you die.

chapters.title: Your account
items: Only people on the guest list can join. Don't share the server address with friends outside the family; ask Eric to add them.
Use your own account. Don't play on someone else's.
Eric keeps a backup of the world every night, so nothing is lost for good.

ladder.title: Blocked message
ladder.text: The message isn't sent, and the bot tells you why in a note only you can see. Say it another way.

ladder.title: Strike
ladder.text: Swear words and mean words count as a strike. After 2 strikes you get a warning.

ladder.title: Chat off for 10 minutes
ladder.text: 3 strikes in 15 minutes turns your chat off for 10 minutes. You can keep playing and building.

ladder.title: Serious message
ladder.text: Telling someone to hurt themselves turns chat off right away, and Eric is told.

ladder.title: Reminder
ladder.text: Eric or your grown-up reminds you of the rule. Most mix-ups end here.

ladder.title: Fix it
ladder.text: If you broke or took something, help put it back. Eric can also roll the world back to last night's backup.

ladder.title: Time out
ladder.text: If it keeps happening, you take a short break from the server.

ladder.title: Talk with your grown-up
ladder.text: If problems keep happening, or someone wrecks other people's builds, Eric talks with your grown-up and you may take a break from the server.

mistakes.moderated: If the bot blocks something that was fine, tell Eric what you typed. He can teach the bot that word is okay. If anything in the world makes you feel uncomfortable, stop playing and tell your grown-up and Eric. You won't be in trouble for telling.
mistakes.off: If anything in the world makes you feel uncomfortable, stop playing and tell your grown-up and Eric. You won't be in trouble for telling.

_events_help: Shown in Game nights and events, plus a banner at the top while one is running.
_showcase_help: Screenshots go in lobby-config/gallery/ (jpg, png or webp). Example: {"image": "castle.png", "title": "Cliffside castle", "by": "nickname", "event": "Spooky Build Contest"}. Nicknames only.

tournament.title: Mario Kart 64 Cup
tournament._status_help: upcoming, live or done. Results: list each race's finishing order, first place first. Points per place follow 'points'.

_hall_help: Past winners, newest first: {"event": "Mario Kart 64 Cup", "date": "2026-10-23", "champion": "nickname"}
_chat_help: Items in rules, rulebook.chapters, chapter items and rulebook.ladder can be {"text": "...", "when": "moderated"} or {"when": "off"}. The page shows the right ones automatically from the live chat state. Plain strings always show.
